template: In Grafana, create a NEW dashboard (Dashboards > New dashboard, or the + Create > Dashboard menu). Add a visualization panel and change its type to Stat. Set the panel title to exactly '{{v3}}'. Set the panel's query data source to the TestData data source (it may be named 'TestData DB' or similar — pick the test data source from the data source picker; if a query editor appears, leave its default scenario). Then click Back/Close the panel editor and SAVE the dashboard with the title exactly '{{v4}}' (choose a folder if asked, e.g. {{v2}} or General). Verify the save succeeded (no unsaved-changes indicator) and report the panel title and data source you ended up with, plus the dashboard title as shown in the breadcrumb.
